iRobot Roomba i3+ EVO replacement parts.

Choose replacement filters, a dual roller-brush refill kit, edge-sweeping side brushes or Clean Base bags for the vacuum-only Roomba i3+ EVO.

Check the variant: This guide is for the vacuum-only Roomba i3+ EVO with its Clean Base. The Amazon robot listing checked here names model 3554. Roomba Combo i3+ (3574) is a separate vacuum-and-mop model; the standard e/i/j refill-kit listing does not establish compatibility with Combo i3+ parts. Buy Clean Base bags only if your setup has that dock.

iRobot Roomba i3+ EVO replacement filters

Three genuine iRobot 4639161 high-efficiency filters.

View replacement filters on Amazon ↗

Fit: The iRobot listing names Roomba e, i and j series. The Roomba i3+ EVO is an i-series robot and is included in iRobot's i3+ EVO refill bundle.

Replace when: iRobot recommends replacing the i-series filter every 2 months, or sooner if it is damaged or airflow stays restricted after cleaning.

Before buying: This filter is not washable: tap debris off and keep it dry. The listing names Combo i5 and j5, but that does not establish fit for Combo i3+.

One matched set of genuine dual multi-surface rubber brushes, three filters and three edge-sweeping brushes.

View roller brush refill kit on Amazon ↗

Fit: iRobot's official refill bundle names Roomba i3+ EVO. This Amazon kit is for the standard e/i/j series and contains the i-series dual rubber brush set.

Replace when: iRobot recommends replacing the dual multi-surface brushes every 6–12 months. Clean wrapped hair and debris weekly, or twice weekly in homes with pets.

Three genuine iRobot 4757625 edge-sweeping brushes.

View side brushes on Amazon ↗

Fit: iRobot lists part 4757625 for Roomba i, e and j series. Its i3+ EVO bundle also includes three edge-sweeping brushes.

Replace when: Clean the side brush monthly. Replace it if the bristles or hub are bent, missing or damaged; iRobot gives no fixed replacement interval.

EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

Roomba i3+ EVO vs. Roomba i3 EVO
iRobot describes i3+ EVO as a vacuum with a Clean Base; the i3 EVO can use that base as a separate accessory. The e/i/j kit covers i-series robot consumables, but Clean Base bags are only needed when the self-emptying dock is installed.
Vacuum-only i3+ EVO vs. Combo i3+
Combo i3+ (3574) is a different vacuum-and-mop setup. The standard kit listing names Combo i5 and j5 but does not establish compatibility with Combo i3+; use a part listing that explicitly names your Combo model.
Robot consumables vs. dock bags
The filter, dual rubber brushes and edge brush install on the robot. The disposable bag belongs in the Clean Base. iRobot lists the i3+ EVO as a compatible Clean Base model; bag compatibility alone does not prove fit for robot parts.
Genuine iRobot parts
All four linked consumable listings are iRobot-branded. The roller-brush refill kit also contains filters and edge brushes; the other cards offer those parts individually and Clean Base bags separately.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

iRobot Roomba i3+ EVO maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

iRobot Roomba i3+ EVO cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
High-efficiency filterWeekly; twice weekly in homes with petsEvery 2 months
Dual multi-surface rubber brushesWeekly; twice weekly in homes with petsEvery 6–12 months
Edge-sweeping brushMonthlyNo fixed interval; replace when worn or damaged
Clean Base bagDisposable; keep the dock evacuation path clearWhen prompted by the Clean Base or app

Roomba e/i/j filters are not washable: tap debris off and keep them dry. Remove hair from both main brush ends and their caps before deciding the rollers need replacing. If the Clean Base has a solid red light, check that the bag is present and seated correctly; a missing or poorly seated bag can trigger the same signal as a full bag.

Before you order

Do Roomba i3 EVO and i3+ EVO use the same robot parts?

iRobot's e/i/j refill kit covers i-series robot consumables. The i3+ package includes a Clean Base, while i3 EVO may have a standard dock; buy Clean Base bags only if that self-emptying dock is installed.

Will this i3+ EVO refill kit fit Roomba Combo i3+?

The standard e/i/j kit listing names Combo i5 and j5, but does not name Combo i3+. Since Combo i3+ is a separate vacuum-and-mop model, verify each replacement against a Combo i3+ specific listing before ordering.

How often should I replace Roomba i3+ EVO filters and brushes?

iRobot recommends replacing the filter every 2 months and the dual rubber brushes every 6–12 months. Clean the filter and main brushes weekly, or twice weekly in homes with pets. Clean the edge brush monthly and replace it when worn or damaged.

Are these genuine iRobot replacement parts?

Yes. The filter, e/i/j replenishment kit, edge-sweeping brushes and Clean Base bags are iRobot-branded listings. Check part numbers and the selected pack on Amazon before ordering because listing variations can change.

Does the Roomba i3+ EVO include a Clean Base?

Yes. iRobot's i3+ EVO product page lists one Clean Base Automatic Dirt Disposal and two dirt-disposal bags in the box. The i3 EVO is a separate package that can use a Clean Base sold separately.
